note: City of Independence Parks & Rec RV park at 301 8th Street SE, on the Wapsipinicon River beside the aquatic center, with river access for canoes, kayaks and fishing. The pads sit behind a wooded riverbank, not on the water. --Claude
summary: Confirmed 42 full-hookup 50A WiFi sites, $35/$150/$400 (seniors $30), phone reservations + some FCFS, showers, Mar 1-Nov 15. Cleared dump (not on the city's amenity list). Riverview confirmed: river ~90 m wide but a tree belt along the bank. Pin fine.
flags: WATERFRONT (riverview confirmed, not on-water): the Wapsipinicon here is about 85-95 m wide (riverfront class, not creekside). The east pull-through row sits east of the campground loop road, so no road is between it and the river, but a continuous deciduous tree and brush belt about 15-25 m deep runs between the pad ends and the bank; on leaf-off Esri imagery it is bare trees, on summer NAIP solid canopy. The south loop ends ~40-50 m from the water behind trees. No open apron, so not riverfront; leaf-off filtered views justify riverview.

FACILITIES: stored dump=true came from note prose; the city's amenity list ('Shower/ restroom facilities ... Garbage Dumpster ...') names no dump station, so dump is cleared to unknown (every site has sewer).
SEASON: the same page says 'season runs March 1st- November 1st' (banner) and 'March 1st- November 15th' (text); kept 11-15 with both in season.note.
BROCHURE: the linked 'RV Campground Brochure 2026.pdf' (DocumentCenter/View/10185) answered with an HTML viewer, not a PDF; not read.
PIN fine: the stored pin is in the riverbank woods ~70 m east of the loop centre.
